title: Da Nang in a day
summary: My Khe in the morning, mi Quang for lunch, and An Thuong after dark. The Cham Museum only if you still want an hour on the river.

stops.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
stops.note: Optional. Take it if you want the stone before the swim.

stops.name: Mi Quang
stops.note: Lunch. Toss the noodles. Do not expect a deep soup.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.note: The morning. Swim only if the flags allow it. The resort front is the view.

stops.name: An Thuong
stops.note: After dark. Walk inland from the beach. Kalà Kalà is on the sand. East West faces the water.

stops.name: Marble Mountains
stops.note: Optional, on the way toward Hoi An. Skip it if the beach used the afternoon.

seoDescription: A one-day Da Nang plan: My Khe in the morning, mi Quang for lunch, and An Thuong after dark.
